title: 1.2 Physics Communities and Their Roles
description: Physics communities, their establishment levels, and the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS)

questions.question: What is a physics community?
options: Higher atmospheric pressure at higher altitude lowers the boiling point
As an organized group of persons associated together for scientific purposes
An organized group of persons associated together for scientific purposes
By enabling new technologies that boost a country's economy and industry
questions.correctAnswer: An organized group of persons associated together for scientific purposes

questions.question: For what purpose are persons associated together in a physics community?
options: For commercial purposes
For entertainment purposes
For political purposes
For scientific purposes

questions.question: How is a physics community best described?
options: Physics improves quality of life and drives technology and economic development
An ordered series of steps to acquire knowledge based on experimental evidence
An organized group of persons associated together for scientific purposes
As an organized group of persons associated together for scientific purposes
questions.correctAnswer: As an organized group of persons associated together for scientific purposes

questions.question: At which levels can physics communities be established?
options: National, continental (regional), and worldwide (global)
To build machines and devices for private companies only
The boiling point of water is constant at every altitude
To promote physics education and research in the country

questions.question: What determines the level at which a physics organization is established?
options: Its age
Its number of members
Its budget
Its aims

questions.question: A national physics society is an example of a physics community established at which level?
options: Worldwide level
Local level
Continental level
National level

questions.question: A continental physics association, such as an African one, represents which level of organization?
options: 300 N toward the 200 N force
A horizontal line below axis
Continental (regional) level
A horizontal line above axis

questions.question: Which of the following is a worldwide (global) physics organization?
options: To promote physics education and research in the country
The boiling point of water is constant at every altitude
IUPAP - International Union of Pure and Applied Physics
International Understanding of Pure and Applied Physics
questions.correctAnswer: IUPAP - International Union of Pure and Applied Physics

questions.question: What does IUPAP stand for?
options: International Union of Pure and Applied Physics
International Understanding of Pure and Applied Physics
Institute of Universal Physics and Applied Principles
International Union of Physics and Astronomy Programs
questions.correctAnswer: International Union of Pure and Applied Physics

questions.question: Which type of physics community is established at the worldwide (global) level?
options: An international union such as IUPAP
100 km/h at 20 degrees North of East
A continental physics association
A national physics society
questions.correctAnswer: An international union such as IUPAP

questions.question: Which of the following is a role of physics communities?
options: To store scientific information for sale
Promoting physics education and research
Recruiting students to universities
Selling physics textbooks for profit

questions.question: How do physics communities share information with scientists?
options: By broadcasting radio programs
By sharing scientific information
Dot product of force and velocity
By selling library memberships

questions.question: Which of the following is an activity carried out by physics communities?
options: Manufacturing laboratory equipment
Administering school examinations
Licensing physics teachers
Organizing conferences

questions.question: How do physics communities help students develop an interest in physics?
options: By popularizing physics
By building laboratories
By setting examination questions
By funding school uniforms

questions.question: Which of the following is a benefit provided by physics communities?
options: Paying teacher salaries
Supplying school furniture
Giving scholarships
Constructing school buildings

questions.question: What equipment support do physics communities provide?
options: Providing equipment and computing facilities
To make students develop interest in physics
delta v over delta t as delta t goes to zero
Providing stationery for schools

questions.question: What does EPS stand for?
options: European Physics Society
Educational Physics System
Ethiopian Physics Society
Ethiopian Physical Sciences

questions.question: Which of the following is an objective of the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS)?
options: The boiling point of water is constant at every altitude
To build machines and devices for private companies only
To promote physics education and research in the country
National, continental (regional), and worldwide (global)
questions.correctAnswer: To promote physics education and research in the country

questions.question: According to the objectives of the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS), what does it organize and coordinate?
options: Conferences on physics education and exchange of scientific information
The most powerful space telescope, launched as the successor to Hubble
Lower atmospheric pressure at higher altitude lowers the boiling point
Higher atmospheric pressure at higher altitude lowers the boiling point
questions.correctAnswer: Conferences on physics education and exchange of scientific information

questions.question: Why does the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS) popularize physics?
options: To make students develop interest in physics
To increase the number of physics teachers
To restrict access to scientific information
To promote physics as a career option
questions.correctAnswer: To make students develop interest in physics

questions.question: In the design and implementation of the physics curriculum, whose active participation does the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS) promote?
options: To focus only on understanding the universe
Pyramid-shaped structure orbiting the Earth
Ethiopian physicists and the general public
Physics is only useful for building weapons
questions.correctAnswer: Ethiopian physicists and the general public

questions.question: Which of the following is an objective of the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS) regarding scientific information?
options: Through experience, observation, and the scientific method
As a random gathering of individuals interested in nature
To create a means for disseminating scientific information
Draw a conclusion that confirms or refutes the hypothesis
questions.correctAnswer: To create a means for disseminating scientific information

questions.question: Which of the following is an objective of the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS) regarding the physics curriculum?
options: Physics improves quality of life and drives technology and economic development
To advance science, engineering, and innovation throughout the world for the benefit of all
To promote active participation in the design and implementation of the physics curriculum
An ordered series of steps to acquire knowledge based on experimental evidence
questions.correctAnswer: To promote active participation in the design and implementation of the physics curriculum

questions.question: Which of the following people are encouraged by the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS) to take part in bringing about an effective physics curriculum?
options: Ethiopian physicists and the general public
To focus only on understanding the universe
Test the taste of boiled water at sea level
Pyramid-shaped structure orbiting the Earth
questions.correctAnswer: Ethiopian physicists and the general public

questions.question: At which level of organization is the Ethiopian Physics Society (EPS) established?
options: Worldwide (global) level
Municipal level
Continental (regional) level
National level
